+    @cached_property
+    def uses_security_scopes(self) -> bool:
+        """
+        Check if this dependency or any of its sub-dependencies use security scopes.
+        """
+        # Check if this dependency uses SecurityScopes parameter
+        if self.security_scopes_param_name:
+            return True
+        # Check if this dependency has security requirements
+        if self.security_requirements:
+            return True
+        # Check if any sub-dependency uses security scopes
+        for sub_dependant in self.dependencies:
+            if sub_dependant.uses_security_scopes:
+                return True
+        return False
+

+        if self.uses_security_scopes:
+            return (

+                tuple(sorted(set(self.security_scopes or []))),
+                self.computed_scope or "",
+            )
